content: GRC platform collaboration on controls/evidence centers on threaded comments/notes attached to a control or evidence item, visible to both internal (compliance team) and external (auditor) participants where auditor access is enabled, used to ask questions, flag gaps, and record resolution reasoning in place of email chains. Comment history is part of the audit trail. Mentions/notifications route to the mentioned user. No evidence found of exotic features (reactions, rich threading/replies-to-replies) being standard; flat chronological comment lists per control are the norm.
